key.name: keybinding-all-windows
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to enter Exposé showing every window on the active workspace. Empty array means no shortcut is bound.

key.name: keybinding-app-expose
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to enter Exposé showing only the windows of the currently focused application. Empty array means no shortcut is bound.

key.name: blur-enabled
key.description: Blur the desktop behind the window previews. Falls back to a plain dim if the compositor cannot capture the screen.

key.name: dim-amount
key.description: How dark the desktop gets behind the window previews (0 = none, 1 = black).

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the window preview frames in pixels.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Duration of the enter/exit animation in milliseconds. Ignored when the system "Reduce Animation" toggle is on.

key.name: max-scale
key.description: Largest size a window preview is allowed to reach, as a percentage of its real size (prevents upscaling a lone small window).

key.name: min-scale
key.description: Smallest size a window preview is allowed to shrink to, as a percentage, when many windows are on screen.
